answer: To prevent adversaries who attempt to forge identity proofs, the protocol binds recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments to a sequential verifiable delay function anchored in a multi-tiered staking terrace. Each validator must lock a basalt collateral asset subject to slashing upon detection of equivocation. This cryptoeconomic model guarantees that the cost of generating duplicate virtual identities strictly exceeds potential rewards, enforcing a robust Nash equilibrium of honest network participation.
